fun_legacy_fp16.resolution: Use current mlx-community/Fun-ASR-Nano-2512 conversion with model_type fun_asr_nano. Old artifact retained in .cache/models/fun-legacy-fp16.

firered_mlx_0_5_4.initial_error: Strict load reports missing encoder.positional_encoding.pe and decoder.positional_encoding.pe
firered_mlx_0_5_4.resolution: asr_lab/firered.py supplies only the two deterministic sinusoidal tables generated by the upstream constructors; all checkpoint weights still load with strict=True. Missing learned and unexpected weights are regression-tested to fail.
firered_mlx_0_5_4.features: Upstream MLX has no hotword prompting or word timestamps. Local contextual beam search now supports opt-in hotwords via asr_lab/hotwords.py and firered_bias.py, with per-phrase reward limited to once per utterance. It returns lowercase text and an unboosted, uncalibrated mean token score for the whole utterance.

firered_hotword_initial_experiment.score4: results/firered-hotwords-4.jsonl: initial per-occurrence reward; superseded by the once-per-utterance implementation.
firered_hotword_initial_experiment.score8: results/firered-hotwords-8.jsonl: repeated 词法分析 in tingting-term08 and repeated 金丝雀 on silence at the 128-token cap; kept as failure evidence.
firered_hotword_initial_experiment.resolution: Disable both completion reward and prefix potential after each phrase has been rewarded once in an utterance. State and rewarded-word set are tracked separately for each beam. VAD remains mandatory in the CLI.
firered_hotword_initial_experiment.default: FireRed is the default ASR, contextual hotwords remain opt-in at score 4.
